note: Hand-written entries only (boss rule 8 Nov: by hand, no generators). Every coordinate below was chosen by eye against the renders in concepts/themes/work/home-fix/shore/. Applied by scripts/home-10/shore.mjs, which only copies these entries in.

harbour.why: Home's harbour moves from the old north-east bay to the big fishing dock on the south coast. The jetty runs down the dock's south stem (fishing-deck.svg art: stem x 3960-4230, y 5626-5921); the art already draws the deck, so the code draws only bollards.

coast.why: The old harbour inlet (north shore y 1150-1290, south shore y 1990-2010, open to the sea east of x 7400) is filled in as land. Points strictly between the two anchors are replaced by this new east beach: a shallow natural cove, x 7492-7625.

riverWater.why: Millrill (mill-stream) used to run out into the old bay and stop in a square cut at 5900,2020; it now ends in Millrill Pond, on the filled land. Its head at the mill was an angular six-point shape; now a rounded millpond.

decks.why: The two ponds are drawn as flat overlays (hand-drawn SVG in world coordinates), so they sit over whatever grass the ground lane paints.

walkWorld.why: rive/web/walk-world.json (the room server's walking map) carries the old jetty deck and the old coast; swap in the new jetty deck (JETTY.walkway of the new jetty) and the same coast.

islets.why: The decorative islet sea-9-1 sat 836 from the sailing corridor between Home's new harbour and isle-251's (needs 1704 for its 1484 width). Moved by hand about 2900 south-south-west, out at sea (Home local ~4500, 10500: 2144 from every coast, 2137 from every harbour corridor).
